crossRefs.note: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which…
Yahweh answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.
I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in…
